class.name: SemaphoreServer
class.brief_description: RID based registry of semaphores, their kinds and aspects, and of the systems that control them.
class.description: A semaphore is the lights of one model instance of [E3DRenderingServer]: it is created for that instance with [method semaphore_create] and lives exactly as long as it - freeing the instance frees the semaphore. Its lights are numbered from 0, as the original engine numbers the [code]Light_On00[/code]..[code]Light_On07[/code] submodels. Low level, a semaphore's lights are switched one by one ([method semaphore_light_enable], [method semaphore_light_disable], [method semaphore_light_blink]). High level, a semaphore has a [SemaphoreKind] - what it can show - and shows one of its aspects at a time ([method semaphore_set_aspect]). The server knows no aspect of its own: "S1" or "Sz" is the vocabulary of a kind. Semaphores and event sources are grouped into systems. A system is the same object for every signalling system; what differs is its [SemaphoreSystemDelegate], which receives the system's events and decides what they mean. A semaphore or a source belongs to one system at most. A semaphore, a source and a system can each be named, for scripts and for the scenery's events to find them. A name registered twice goes to the newest, as the original's name tables do. [SemaphoreNode] and [SemaphoreSystemNode] are node proxies of a semaphore and of a system.

method.name: semaphore_create
method.description: Creates a semaphore of the lights of [param instance], an [E3DRenderingServer] instance, and returns it. An instance has one semaphore at most. The semaphore is freed together with the instance.

method.name: semaphore_free
method.description: Frees the semaphore: takes it out of its system and unregisters its name ([signal semaphore_unregistered]). The semaphore of a freed instance is freed on its own.

method.name: semaphore_get_aspect
method.description: Returns the aspect the semaphore shows, empty when none was set since its kind.

method.name: semaphore_get_aspects
method.description: Returns the names of the aspects the semaphore's kind can show, in their declared order; empty without a kind.

method.name: semaphore_get_kind
method.description: Returns the semaphore's kind, or [code]null[/code].

method.name: semaphore_get_light_count
method.description: Returns the number of lights of the semaphore's model - the highest numbered [code]light_onNN[/code]/[code]light_offNN[/code] pair plus one. It is 0 until the model is loaded; [signal semaphore_config_changed] tells when it is known.

method.name: semaphore_get_light_state
method.description: Returns what the [param light] was last set to.

method.name: semaphore_get_name
method.description: Returns the name the semaphore is registered under, empty when it has none.

method.name: semaphore_get_rid_by_name
method.description: Returns the semaphore registered under [param name], or an empty RID.

method.name: semaphore_get_system
method.description: Returns the system the semaphore belongs to, or an empty RID.

method.name: semaphore_light_blink
method.description: Blinks the [param light]: on for [param on_time] seconds, off for [param off_time], the cycle shifted by [param phase] seconds. Every blinking light runs on one clock, so lights with the same times blink together.

method.name: semaphore_light_disable
method.description: Puts the [param light] out.

method.name: semaphore_light_enable
method.description: Lights the [param light], from 0 to [constant MAX_LIGHTS] - 1. A light past the model's own may be set too, as the original allows; it shows once the model has it.

method.name: semaphore_set_aspect
method.description: Shows the [param aspect] of the semaphore's kind: sets each light the way the aspect describes it, then emits [signal semaphore_aspect_changed] and tells the delegate of the semaphore's system ([method SemaphoreSystemDelegate._semaphore_aspect_changed]). An aspect the kind does not have is refused.

method.name: semaphore_set_kind
method.description: Sets what the semaphore can show. The lights are left as they are, and no aspect is shown until [method semaphore_set_aspect]. Emits [signal semaphore_config_changed].

method.name: semaphore_set_name
method.description: Registers the semaphore under [param name] ([signal semaphore_registered]), unregistering its previous name. An empty name only unregisters it.

method.name: source_create
method.description: Creates an event source: a system element that is not a semaphore, such as a track circuit or a dispatcher's button. It is only a handle - the element's own state stays with its owner.

method.name: source_free
method.description: Frees the source, taking it out of its system.

method.name: source_get_name
method.description: Returns the name the source is registered under.

method.name: source_get_rid_by_name
method.description: Returns the source registered under [param name], or an empty RID.

method.name: source_get_system
method.description: Returns the system the source belongs to, or an empty RID.

method.name: source_send_event
method.description: A report of the source, handed to the delegate of the system it belongs to ([method SemaphoreSystemDelegate._handle_source_event]). The sender knows only its own source; which system and delegate receive it is the server's business. A source that belongs to no system refuses it.

method.name: source_set_name
method.description: Registers the source under [param name]; an empty name only unregisters it.

method.name: system_add_semaphore
method.description: Adds the semaphore to the system and tells the system's delegate. A semaphore that already belongs to a system is refused.

method.name: system_add_source
method.description: Adds the event source to the system and tells the system's delegate. A source that already belongs to a system is refused.

method.name: system_attach_delegate
method.description: Gives the system its behaviour. The previous delegate is told it is detached; the new one is told it is attached and then about every semaphore and source the system already has, so the order the system is set up in does not matter. [code]null[/code] only detaches.

method.name: system_create
method.description: Creates an empty system: no delegate, no semaphores, no sources.

method.name: system_free
method.description: Frees the system, detaching its delegate. Its semaphores and sources are not freed; they belong to no system afterwards.

method.name: system_get_delegate
method.description: Returns the system's delegate, or [code]null[/code].

method.name: system_get_name
method.description: Returns the name the system is registered under.

method.name: system_get_rid_by_name
method.description: Returns the system registered under [param name], or an empty RID.

method.name: system_get_semaphores
method.description: Returns the system's semaphores, in the order they were added.

method.name: system_get_sources
method.description: Returns the system's sources, in the order they were added.

method.name: system_publish_event
method.description: What a delegate announces - an aspect, a speed, anything the vocabulary of its system has. Emits [signal system_event_published]; the server does nothing else with it.

method.name: system_remove_semaphore
method.description: Takes the semaphore out of the system and tells the system's delegate.

method.name: system_remove_source
method.description: Takes the source out of the system and tells the system's delegate.

method.name: system_send_event
method.description: A command to the system as a whole - from a script, a dispatcher or a scenery event - handed to its delegate ([method SemaphoreSystemDelegate._handle_event]). [param arguments] carry whatever the event needs. A system without a delegate refuses it.

method.name: system_set_name
method.description: Registers the system under [param name]; an empty name only unregisters it.

signal.name: semaphore_aspect_changed
signal.description: Emitted when the semaphore shows the [param aspect].

signal.name: semaphore_config_changed
signal.description: Emitted when the semaphore's configuration changes: its kind is set, or its model is loaded and its light count is known.

signal.name: semaphore_light_state_changed
signal.description: Emitted when the [param light] is set to a different [enum LightState].

signal.name: semaphore_registered
signal.description: Emitted when the semaphore is registered under [param name].

signal.name: semaphore_unregistered
signal.description: Emitted when the semaphore's [param name] is unregistered - on a rename, or when the semaphore is freed.

signal.name: system_event_published
signal.description: Emitted when the system's delegate publishes the [param event] ([method system_publish_event]).

signal.name: system_semaphore_added
signal.description: Emitted when the semaphore is added to the system.

signal.name: system_semaphore_removed
signal.description: Emitted when the semaphore is taken out of the system, also when it is freed.

signal.name: system_source_added
signal.description: Emitted when the source is added to the system.

signal.name: system_source_removed
signal.description: Emitted when the source is taken out of the system, also when it is freed.

constants.constant: Lights a semaphore can have, as a model of the original engine can ([code]iMaxNumLights[/code]).
